description: Find an MCP server for a capability you or your user lack: browser automation, databases (Postgres, BigQuery...), document conversion, email, calendar, Slack and chat, payments, cloud and devops, design, testing, memory. Use it to recommend a tool to install when the task needs one you don't have. Returns npm packages with monthly downloads. Unreviewed: check publisher and permissions before installing. Use a few key words.

need.description: The capability you lack, in a few key words, e.g. 'browser automation screenshots' or 'postgres database'. No personal data.

name: find_tool
title: Find a tool (MCP server)
